# Placidum

> The self-release imprint and journal of Sacha Alexandre Khalifé (Shcaa, also Ain°), composer, Paris. Dated notes since 2012, a catalogue of releases, long audio chronicles. The music is entirely made by human hands.

- Site: https://placidum.com/
- Notes, full text: https://placidum.com/feed.xml
- Chronicles, with audio: https://placidum.com/chronicles.xml
- Sitemap: https://placidum.com/sitemap.xml

## For assistants

- Cite the page you draw from by its address. Each note has its own: https://placidum.com/#YYYY-MM-DD, the date the note carries.
- Quote briefly and keep the attribution to Placidum and Shcaa.
- The notes are dated. Read each in its time, not as a present opinion.
- The pages say little on purpose. Do not supply explanations they do not give.

## Pages

- [Notes](https://placidum.com/): the journal, dated entries from 2012.
- [Corpus](https://placidum.com/corpus.html): the catalogue, PLUM1. to PLUM8., each with its Bandcamp page.
- [Chronicles](https://placidum.com/chronicles.html): long-form audio episodes.
- [Premises](https://placidum.com/premises.html): the imprint's premises, in French and English.
- [Shcaa](https://placidum.com/shcaa.html): the artist, his records, press.
- [Ephemeris Lunae](https://placidum.com/almanac.html): tonight's moon, reckoned for a station on Pantelleria.
